H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H516: 'Thou must not destroy'; probably the opening words to a popular song
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
H7586: Shaul, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H4191: to die (literally or figuratively); causatively, to kill
H5337: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
H7682: to be (causatively, make) lofty, especially inaccessible; by implication, safe, strong; used literally and figuratively
H6466: to do or make (systematically and habitually), especially to practise
H205: strictly nothingness; also trouble. vanity, wickedness; specifically an idol
H376: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
H1818: blood (as that which when shed causes death) of man or an animal; by analogy, the juice of the grape; figuratively (especially in the plural) bloodshed (i.e. drops of blood)
H3467: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H1481: properly, to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), i.e. sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather forhostility (as afraid)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H2403: an offence (sometimes habitual sinfulness), and its penalty, occasion, sacrifice, or expiation; also (concretely) an offender
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H1097: properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.
H7323: to run (for whatever reason, especially to rush)
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H7125: an encountering, accidental, friendly or hostile (also adverbially, opposite)
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H6635: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H6485: to visit (with friendly or hostile intent); by analogy, to oversee, muster, charge, care for, miss, deposit, etc.
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H1471: a foreign nation; hence, a Gentile; also (figuratively) a troop of animals, or a flight of locusts
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H2603: properly, to bend or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to favor, bestow; causatively to implore (i.e. move to favor by petition)
H898: to cover (with a garment); figuratively, to act covertly; by implication, to pillage
H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H1993: to make a loud sound (like English 'hum'); by implication, to be in great commotion or tumult, to rage, war, moan, clamor
H3611: a dog; hence (by euphemism) a male prostitute
H5437: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively
H5892: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
H5042: to gush forth; figuratively, to utter (good or bad words); specifically, to emit (a foul odor)
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H2719: drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement
H8193: the lip (as a natural boundary); by implication, language; by analogy, a margin (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.)
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H7832: to laugh (in pleasure or detraction); by implication, to play
H3932: to deride; by implication (as if imitating a foreigner) to speak unintelligibly
H5797: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H4869: defence, high fort (tower), refuge, Misgab, a place in Moab
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H6923: to project (one self), i.e. precede; hence, to anticipate, hasten, meet (usually for help)
H8324: to be hostile (only active participle an opponent)
H6435: properly, removal; used only (in the construction) adverb as conjunction, lest
H7911: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H5128: to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined)
H2428: probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength
H3381: to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications)
H4043: a shield (i.e. the small one or buckler); figuratively, a protector; also the scaly hide of the crocodile
H136: the Lord (used as a proper name of God only)
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H3920: to catch (in a net, trap or pit); generally, to capture or occupy; also to choose (by lot); figuratively, to cohere
H3585: literally a failure of flesh, i.e. emaciation; figuratively, hypocrisy
H5608: properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate
H3615: to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume)
H2534: heat; figuratively, anger, poison (from its fever)
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H657: cessation, i.e. an end (especially of the earth); often used adverb, no further; also the ankle (in the dual), as being the extremity of the leg or foot
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H7646: to sate, i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively)
H3885: to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain)
H7442: properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy)
H1242: properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H4498: a retreat (literally or figuratively); abstractly, a fleeing
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H6862: narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble ; (transitive) an opponent (as crowding)
H2167: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
